description: Haarlemmerdijk cornice shop houses whose brick stops under a deep cream attic frieze and cornice about 1-1.5 m tall, with a small crowned piece over the middle, and no roof face seen over it: 3.8-7.6 m fronts, two axes of white-framed windows over a cream shop (Haarlemmerdijk 6 and 18)

match.note: Reviewer-placed only (type and crown pins): the frieze is read on the 1 m grid, not by the scorer. Eaves = the cornice top over the frieze.. columnsPerBay [1, 2]: the T-window's mullion under the transom reads as a second column (Haarlemmerdijk 23E: 6 columns over 3 axes)

frieze-crowned.note: the deep cream frieze with a small crowned piece over the middle instead of a dormer on a roof face (Haarlemmerdijk 6, 176172: band 10.0-11.0 m, crown to 12.2 m; 18, 167817: band 10.0-11.4 m, crown to 12.3 m)

frieze.note: a deep cream attic frieze and cornice about 1.5 m tall over the brick (Haarlemmerdijk 18, 167817: brick to 10.0 m, band 10.0-11.4 m; strip-sheet review 2026-11-10)

door-left.note: residential ground: house door on the left axis; shops come per pand from BAG/OSM (autoShopfront)

roof.evidence: Haarlemmerdijk 6 (176172) and 18 (167817), 2022-12-15 strips and the strip-sheet review 2026-11-10: sky directly over the frieze and its crown, no roof face; 3DBAG p95 11.21 m over a 10.9 m cornice on 6 and 9.69 m under an 11.4 m cornice on 18, so the roof behind is near flat. The front-hipped red saddle of haarlemmer-shop-cornice drew a red face over the frieze that the review rejected

rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: a shop (BAG/OSM) or a house door and window | upper: 2 or 3
rhythm.groundFloor: a tall shop ground 4.4-4.9 m to the fascia top on the dijk and straat
rhythm.roofline: a deep cream attic frieze and cornice with a small crowned piece over the middle
schemaLimits: the cornice frieze and consoles are a plain slab
the crowned piece is a plain pediment cap, not the moulded dormer front

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2022-12-15 at 1.8x, 1 m grid: brick to 10.0 m, cream band to 11.0 m (6) and 11.4 m (18), crowned piece to 12.2-12.3 m; shop joinery cream
